title: 第一卷 第17章 青鸾真神将皇帝的谋划第一卷 第18章 啥也没干我就封王了
slug: 自曝万嗣呈祥父皇给我疯狂赐婚
content_zh:
一声清越的剑鸣。
李青鸾不知何时，手中已多了一柄三尺青锋。
她凌空而立，衣袂飘飘，一股远超刺客的强大气息，轰然爆发！
那气息平和中正，却又浩瀚如海，带着一股衍化万物的玄奥道韵。
“《大道天衍经》？”
赵辰安在车内看得分明，心中一动。
她竟然已经能将功法运用到实战中了！
那两名道宫境的刺客，在感受到李青鸾气息的瞬间，动作齐齐一滞。
情报有误！
不是说十六皇子妃只是个初入道宫的武者吗？
这股气息，分明已经道宫圆满，甚至隐隐触摸到了四极境的门槛！
“杀！”
短暂的震惊后，是更凶狠的杀意。
两人对视一眼，放弃了其他护卫，同时化作两道黑影，一左一右，夹击李青鸾！
面对两名同阶强者的围攻，李青鸾神色不变。
她手腕一抖，长剑挽出一个剑花。
“道生一。”
她轻声念道。
剑尖之上，一道剑气迸发，看似平平无奇，却瞬间分化为二，又化为三。
最终演化成漫天剑雨，将两名刺客笼罩其中。

每一道剑气，都蕴含着一丝大道至理，玄奥莫测。
两名刺客大骇，连忙挥刀抵挡。
叮叮当当！
密集的金铁交鸣声响起。
他们惊恐地发现，自己的刀势，在对方那看似轻飘飘的剑雨面前，竟如同纸糊的一般，被轻易撕碎！
噗！
噗！
血花飞溅。
只一个照面，两名道宫境的刺客，便被剑气洞穿了身体，浑身浴血，踉跄后退。
车厢内，赵辰安看得热血沸腾，忍不住低喝一声。
“青鸾真神将！”
这才是将门虎女该有的风采！
这才是天品功法该有的威力！
一击得手，李青鸾并未停歇。
她身影一晃，主动欺身而上，长剑如龙，直取其中一名刺客的咽喉。
那刺客亡魂大冒，举刀格挡，却被李青鸾一剑连人带刀。
直接震飞出去，重重地砸在墙上，口喷鲜血，再也爬不起来。
剩下的那名刺客，彻底吓破了胆。
他想也不想，转身就逃。
“想走？”

李青鸾冷哼一声，屈指一弹。
一道剑气破空而去，精准地洞穿了那名刺客的膝盖。
content_en:
There was a clear sword cry.
Li Qingluan didn't know when he had a three-foot green blade in his hand.
She stood in the air, her clothes fluttering, and a powerful aura that far surpassed that of an assassin exploded!
The aura was peaceful and upright, yet as vast as the sea, carrying a mysterious Taoist charm that inspired all things.
""Dao Tianyan Jing"?"
Zhao Chenan saw clearly in the car and was moved in his heart.
She has actually been able to apply the skills in actual combat!
The two Dao Palace level assassins froze in their movements the moment they felt Li Qingluan's aura.
The information is wrong!
Didn't it mean that the Sixteenth Princess was just a warrior who had just entered the Taoist Palace?
This aura has clearly reached the perfection of the Dao Palace, and even faintly touched the threshold of the Four Extremes Realm!
"Kill!"
After a brief shock, there was a more ferocious murderous intention.
The two looked at each other, gave up the other guards, and turned into two black shadows at the same time, one on the left and one on the right, flanking Li Qingluan!
Facing the siege of two powerful men of the same level, Li Qingluan's expression remained unchanged.
With a flick of her wrist, she drew a sword flower from her long sword.
"Tao Shengyi."
She whispered.
Above the sword tip, a sword energy burst out. It seemed ordinary, but it split into two and then into three in an instant.
Eventually it turned into a rain of swords, covering the two assassins.
Every sword energy contains a trace of great truth, which is mysterious and unpredictable.
The two assassins were horrified and quickly waved their swords to resist.
Ding-ding-ding-ding!
The dense sound of gold and iron echoed.
They were horrified to find that their swords were torn apart easily like paper in front of the opponent's seemingly light sword rain!
puff!
puff!
Blood splattered.
After just one encounter, the two Taoist palace-level assassins were pierced by sword energy. They were covered in blood and staggered back.
In the carriage, Zhao Chenan's blood boiled with excitement and he couldn't help but let out a low drink.
"Qingluan True Divine General!"
This is the style that a general tiger girl should have!
This is the power that Tianpin Kung Fu should have!
After a successful blow, Li Qingluan did not stop.
Her figure flashed, and she took the initiative to bully him, her long sword like a dragon going straight to the throat of one of the assassins.
The assassin's ghost appeared, and he raised his sword to block, but was struck by Li Qingluan's sword.
He flew straight away and hit the wall hard. Blood spurted from his mouth and he could no longer get up.
The remaining assassin was completely frightened.
Without thinking, he turned around and ran away.
"Want to leave?"
Li Qingluan snorted coldly and flicked his fingers.
A sword energy shot through the air and accurately pierced the assassin's knee.
